facts.fact: Novo Jornal reports that the National Assembly's committees have been discussing the Civil and Criminal Identification bill (Proposta de Lei da Identificacao Civil e Criminal) in committee stage since 29 October 2026; it makes the Bilhete de Identidade the sole valid and mandatory citizen ID.
